lead_fa: Retribution Paladin یک DPS مبارز با Holy Power است که با [[Final Verdict]] و [[Divine Storm]] و زنجیرهٔ کول‌داون‌هایش ([[Avenging Wrath]] و [[Execution Sentence]]) آسیب می‌زند. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Templar]] با برست پنجره‌کوتاه و [[Hammer of Light]]، و [[Herald of the Sun]] با آسیب دوره‌ای و کلوی پایدار؛ فاصلهٔ این دو کم است و بسته به پروفایل آسیب هر دو ارزش بازی دارند.

strengths: Easy to learn playstyle that does not punish mistakes harshly
Many strong defensive tools, both passive and active like Divine Shield and Divine Protection
Plenty of utility options that find uses in any type of content
Strong self-healing and off-healing options for the group
weaknesses: Low-side mobility: Divine Steed is the main option
Utility can be redundant in high-end content
Low skill ceiling: not much nuance beyond the basics

nerfs: Avenging Wrath reduced to 15% Critical Strike chance and damage
buffs: Damage of all main generators and spenders increased
Crusading Strikes now increases attack speed instead of reducing it, but no longer generates extra Holy Power with Skyfury
Art of War can now stack twice
changes_12_1.note: Season 2 moved damage away from cooldowns into sustained damage and adjusted Crusading Strikes.

hero.recommendation: Both heroes are very competitive: Templar is better at short-window burst damage on single target and AoE and has stronger defensives; Herald of the Sun has better sustained cleave and AoE and stronger burst over longer windows. The gap is not significant for any PvE content, so play whichever fits the damage profile you need. In Mythic+, Templar wins when enemies die very quickly or when you need survivability to live one-shots; Herald of the Sun is stronger for longer pulls.
hero.templar: Gain access to Hammer of Light, a powerful Holy Power spender for burst windows, plus Empyrean Hammers raining automatically through spells and buffs.
hero.herald_of_the_sun: Focused on periodic damage effects, especially Dawnlight; these trigger automatically during cooldowns, plus buffs to Divine Storm and Hammer of Wrath.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead marks both trees (Best) in Raid and Mythic+; the guidance is to pick by damage profile rather than a fixed winner.

concepts: Holy Power economy: generating and spending Holy Power is the majority of your damage; do not waste it by generating above what you need.
Use procs: Light Within is wasted if Blade of Justice is not used fast enough; Art of War stacks to 2, so spend them promptly with a little leeway.
Manage cooldowns: usually press on cooldown, but hold slightly when abilities need to line up or for mechanics and add spawns.
Holy Power economy: do not generate more than you can spend.
Spend Art of War and Light Within procs quickly.
Keep cooldowns aligned; hold only when it makes them line up better.
st_priority: Cast Divine Storm with a Divine Arbiter proc from Final Verdict and 5 Holy Power
Cast Final Verdict with 5 Holy Power
Cast Blade of Justice with 2 stacks of Art of War if Avenging Wrath is not active
Cast Hammer of Wrath with 2 charges
Cast Divine Storm with a Divine Arbiter proc from Final Verdict
rotation.aoe_note: The AoE version shifts emphasis toward Divine Storm and cleave: Herald of the Sun is stronger for sustained cleave and longer pulls while Templar bursts harder in short AoE windows. Keep Expurgation and Judgment debuffs maintained on all targets.

cooldowns.Execution Sentence: Fit as much damage as possible inside its window; all damage to targets hit by the initial damage counts toward the funnel portion, so keep using AoE abilities on multiple targets.
cooldowns.Avenging Wrath: Rather than casting Execution Sentence right after Avenging Wrath, hold it until Crusade is stacked up, starting in the opener and repeating each cooldown sequence; optimally worth less than 1%, but a loss when played suboptimally. It also means all Divine Resonance-buffed Hammer of Wraths land inside Execution Sentence.

gearing_rules: Strength is primary; item level increases on Strength pieces generally win.
Secondary guideline: Mastery > Haste > Critical Strike > Versatility, varying with your gear and build; sim with Raidbots.
Use the Matrix Catalyst on the recommended non-tier pieces to complete the 4-piece bonus.

Embellishments: Loa Worshiper's Band plus Stabilizing Gemstone Bandolier; with Loa Worshiper's Band equipped, gem all sockets with Flawless Masterful Peridot except the Indecipherable Eversong Diamond.

tier_set.name: Radiance of the Consecrated Flame
tier_set.note: 2pc: Divine Purpose has an additional 10% chance to activate, and consuming it grants Divine Power, increasing Holy damage done by 10% for 12 sec. 4pc: consuming Divine Purpose grants Divine Arbiter, empowering your other Holy Power spenders to unleash an arbiter of light at their primary target, dealing Holy damage to enemies within 8 yds.

crafted: Blood Knight's Warblade with Hunter's Ritual Stone (optional early craft)

Simulating with Raidbots is recommended for personalized priorities.

mplus.hero_note: Templar is stronger when enemies die very quickly or when you need the extra survivability to live one-shots; Herald of the Sun is stronger for longer pulls with sustained cleave.
tips: Divine Shield and Divine Protection cover both immunity needs and regular damage reduction on trash and bosses.
Blessing of Sacrifice, Blessing of Protection and Blessing of Spellwarding remain top-tier dungeon utilities.
Hold cooldowns briefly for big trash packs instead of pressing into dying pulls; Templar bursts best in short windows.
Keep Expurgation and Judgment debuffs up across packs to carry cleave damage.
Mobility is limited to Divine Steed: position early for mechanics.
